protocol_variants.title: Paper separation of lead and cadmium
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Apply 1-2% lead/cadmium nitrate sample solution to 4 by 17 cm paper with baseline 3 cm from its end.
procedure_steps.observation: Dry sample spots are above the mobile-phase level.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Develop in ethanol : 6 M nitric acid : water, 8:1:1 by volume; keep solvent below the baseline.
procedure_steps.observation: The source specifies a ratio, not a total mobile-phase volume.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Mark the solvent front, dry and apply ammonium sulphide developer.
procedure_steps.observation: Lead gives black and cadmium yellow spots; measure distances for Rf.
